H4344.name: Machbannai
H4344.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4344.brief: Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
H4344.short: Machbannai, a Gadite warrior, was one of the men who joined David at Ziklag.

H4343.name: Machbenah
H4343.desc: Woman or town of at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4343.brief: Daughter or town founded by Sheva
H4343.short: Machbenah was a descendant or town of Caleb, the son of Hezron, from the tribe of Judah.

H4352.name: Machi
H4352.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4352.brief: Father of Geuel, from the tribe of Gad
H4352.short: Machi was the father of Geuel, a scout from the tribe of Gad sent to explore Canaan.

H4353H.name: Machir
H4353H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H4353H.short: Machir, the son of Ammiel, hosted Mephibosheth, Jonathan's son, in Lo-debar and later provided supplies to David during Absalom's rebellion.

H4353G.name: Machir
H4353G.desc: Manasseh's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4353G.brief: Son of Manasseh; father (ie re-founder) of Gilead
H4353G.short: Machir, the son of Manasseh, was the father  (ie re-founder) of Gilead and a prominent figure in the tribe of Manasseh.

H4367.name: Machnadebai
H4367.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4367.brief: One of those who married foreign women
H4367.short: Machnadebai was among those who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

H4308G.name: Matred
H4308G.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4308G.brief: Mother of Mehetabel, wife of Hadar, king of Edom.
H4308G.short: Matred was the mother of Mehetabel, who was the wife of Hadar, king of Edom.

H4309.name: Matri
H4309.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H4309.brief: Saul's ancestral clan from the tribe of Benjamin.
H4309.short: The Matrite (or Matri) clan was Saul's ancestral clan from the tribe of Benjamin.

H4382.name: Mecherathites
H4382.brief: Clan or inhabitants of an unknown place called Mecherah.
H4382.short: The Mecherathites were a clan or inhabitants of an unknown place called Mecherah.
H4382.meaning: “he of the dug-out” or “he of the digging tool”

forms.meaning: “he of the dug-out” or “he of the digging tool”

H4312.name: Medad
H4312.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4312.brief: Eldad's companion who prophesied in the Israelite camp.
H4312.short: Medad, along with Eldad, prophesied in the Israelite camp, though they had not gone to the tent of meeting.

H4337.name: Mesha
H4337.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4337.brief: Son of Caleb and founder of Ziph.
H4337.short: Mesha, a son of Caleb, was the  father (ie founder) of Ziph.

H4331.name: Mesha
H4331.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4331.brief: A descendant of Benjamin born in Moab.
H4331.short: Mesha, a descendant of Benjamin, was born to Shaharaim in the country of Moab.

H4338.name: Mesha
H4338.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4338.brief: King of Moab who rebelled against Israel.
H4338.short: Mesha, king of Moab, rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

H4314.name: Mezahab
H4314.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4314.brief: Grandfather of Mehetabel, wife of Edomite king Hadar.
H4314.short: Mezahab was the grandfather of Mehetabel, who was the wife of Hadar, an Edomite king.

H4316G.name: Mica
H4316G.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H4316G.brief: A Levite who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.
H4316G.short: Mica (or Micah), a Levite, lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H4316H.name: Mica
H4316H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4316H.brief: A priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
H4316H.short: Mica, a priest, was among those who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.

H4316I.name: Mica
H4316I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4316I.brief: A Levite leader in Jerusalem after the exile.
H4316I.short: Mica (or Micaiah), a Levite leader, served in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H4318J.name: Micah
H4318J.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4318J.brief: A Levite, son of Uzziel, during David's reign.
H4318J.short: Micah, a Levite and son of Uzziel, served during the reign of King David.

H4318I.name: Micah
H4318I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4318I.short: Micah, a descendant of Joel, is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Reuben.

H4318H.name: Micah
H4318H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H4318H.brief: Son of Mephibosheth, grandson of Jonathan.
H4318H.short: Micah (or Mica), the son of Mephibosheth and grandson of Jonathan, is mentioned in the genealogies of the tribe of Benjamin.

H4318G.name: Micah
H4318G.brief: A man from Ephraim who set up idolatrous worship.
H4318G.short: Micah, a man from the hill country of Ephraim, set up idolatrous worship in his house, which was later adopted by the Danites.

H4318K.name: Micah
H4318K.desc: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4318K.brief: A prophet from Moresheth during the reigns of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah.
H4318K.short: Micah, a prophet from Moresheth, prophesied during the reigns of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

H4321G.name: Micaiah
H4321G.desc: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4321G.brief: A prophet who foretold King Ahab's death.
H4321G.short: Micaiah (or Micahu), a prophet, foretold the death of King Ahab of Israel in battle against the Arameans.

H4322G.name: Micaiah
H4322G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4322G.brief: A Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law.
H4322G.short: Micaiah, a Levite, was among those sent by King Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

H4320G.name: Micaiah
H4320G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4320G.brief: A Levite sent by King Josiah to inquire of the Lord.
H4320G.short: Micaiah (or Micah), a Levite, was sent by King Josiah to inquire of the Lord after the discovery of the Book of the Law.

H4321H.name: Micaiah
H4321H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4321H.brief: Son of Gemariah, reported Baruch's reading of Jeremiah's scroll.
H4321H.short: Micaiah, the son of Gemariah, reported to the officials about Baruch's reading of Jeremiah's scroll to the people.

H4320H.name: Micaiah
H4320H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4320H.brief: A priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.
H4320H.short: Micaiah, a priest, participated in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

H4317M.name: Michael
H4317M.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4317M.brief: A Manassite who joined David at Ziklag.
H4317M.short: Michael, a Manassite, was one of the men who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from King Saul.

H4317N.name: Michael
H4317N.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4317N.brief: A leader of the tribe of Issachar under David.
H4317N.short: Michael, the son of Omri, was the leader of the tribe of Issachar during King David's reign.

H4317H.name: Michael
H4317H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4317H.brief: A Gadite chief during the reign of Jotham.
H4317H.short: Michael, a Gadite chief, is mentioned among the leaders of the tribe of Gad during the reign of Jotham, king of Judah.

H4317I.name: Michael
H4317I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4317I.brief: A Gadite chief, descendant of Abihail.
H4317I.short: Michael, a descendant of Abihail, was one of the Gadite chiefs mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Gad.

H4317J.name: Michael
H4317J.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4317J.brief: A Levite musician, son of Baaseiah.
H4317J.short: Michael, a Levite and descendant of Merari, was the son of Baaseiah and is mentioned in the genealogy of the Levitical musicians.

H4317K.name: Michael
H4317K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4317K.brief: Son of Uzzi, a descendant of Issachar.
H4317K.short: Michael, a descendant of Issachar, was one of the sons of Uzzi.

H4317L.name: Michael
H4317L.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4317L.short: Michael, a Benjamite, was one of the sons of Beriah mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

H4317O.name: Michael
H4317O.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4317O.brief: A son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah.
H4317O.short: Michael was one of the sons of King Jehoshaphat of Judah.

H4317Q.name: Michael
H4317Q.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4317Q.brief: An archangel who fights for God's people.
H4317Q.short: Michael, the archangel, is mentioned in the Bible as a heavenly being who fights for God's people and contends with evil forces.

H4317P.name: Michael
H4317P.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4317P.brief: A descendant of Shephatiah who returned with Ezra.
H4317P.short: Michael, a descendant of Shephatiah, was among those who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.

H4317G.name: Michael
H4317G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4317G.brief: A spy from the tribe of Asher.
H4317G.short: Michael, from the tribe of Asher, was one of the twelve spies sent by Moses to scout out the land of Canaan.

H4324G.name: Michal
H4324G.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H4324G.brief: Daughter of Saul; wife of David.
H4324G.short: Michal, the younger daughter of King Saul, became David's wife and helped him escape from Saul's attempts to kill him.

H4381.name: Michri
H4381.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4381.brief: A Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem.
H4381.short: Michri, a Benjamite, is mentioned in the list of the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

H4326G.name: Mijamin
H4326G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4326G.brief: A priest in the time of David.
H4326G.short: Mijamin, a priest, was the head of the sixth division of the priestly order during the reign of David.

H4326H.name: Mijamin
H4326H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4326H.brief: An Israelite who married a foreign woman.
H4326H.short: Mijamin, an Israelite, was among those who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

H4326I.name: Mijamin
H4326I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4326I.brief: A priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
H4326I.short: Mijamin (or Miniamin), a priest, was among those who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah and served as a leader of the priestly division.

H4332I.name: Mishael
H4332I.desc: Daniel's compatriot living at the time of Exile and Return
H4332I.brief: A Jewish exile in Babylon, friend of Daniel.
H4332I.short: Mishael, also known as Meshach, was one of the four young Jewish men chosen to serve in Nebuchadnezzar's court and was a companion of Daniel during the Babylonian exile.

H4332G.name: Mishael
H4332G.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4332G.brief: A Levite who helped remove the bodies of Nadab and Abihu.
H4332G.short: Mishael, a Levite and cousin of Aaron, assisted in removing the bodies of Nadab and Abihu after they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord.

H4332H.name: Mishael
H4332H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4332H.brief: A Levite who stood beside Ezra during the reading of the Law.
H4332H.short: Mishael, a Levite, was one of those who stood beside Ezra as he read the Book of the Law to the people.

H4307G.name: Guard Gate
H4307G.brief: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, likely the Muster Gate.
H4307G.short: The Guard Gate was a gate in Jerusalem's wall, mentioned in <ref="Nehemiah 12:39">Nehemiah 12:39</ref>, likely the same as the Muster Gate near the Temple.

H4375.name: Machpelah
H4375.brief: A cave near Hebron; burial place of patriarchs
H4375.short: Machpelah, a cave near Hebron purchased by Abraham as a burial place for Sarah and later used for other patriarchs (<ref="Genesis 23:9, 17-19">Genesis 23:9, 17-19</ref>).

H4368.name: Meconah
H4368.brief: A town inhabited by the people of Judah after the exile
H4368.short: Meconah, a town inhabited by the people of Judah after their return from the Babylonian exile (<ref="Nehemiah 11:28">Nehemiah 11:28</ref>).

H4311.name: Medeba
H4311.brief: A Moabite city captured by the Israelites
H4311.short: Medeba, a city in Moab captured by the Israelites (<ref="Numbers 21:30; Joshua 13:9, 16">Numbers 21:30; Joshua 13:9, 16</ref>), later a site of battle between the Ammonites and David's army (<ref="1Ch.19.7">1Ch.19.7</ref>).

H4313.name: Me-jarkon
H4313.brief: A place in the territory of Dan
H4313.short: Me-jarkon, a place in the territory allotted to the tribe of Dan (<ref="Joshua 19:46">Joshua 19:46</ref>).

H4363.name: Michmash
H4363.brief: A town in Benjamin; site of Saul's camp and Jonathan's victory
H4363.short: Michmash, a town in Benjamin where Saul camped (<ref="1Sa.13.2">1Sa.13.2, 5, 11, 16, 23</ref>) and near which Jonathan defeated a Philistine garrison (<ref="1Sa.14.5, 31">1Sa.14.5, 31</ref>).

H4366.name: Michmethath
H4366.brief: A place on the borders of Ephraim and Manasseh
H4366.short: Michmethath, a place on the border between the territories of Ephraim and Manasseh (<ref="Joshua 16:6; 17:7">Joshua 16:6; 17:7</ref>).

H4389.name: Mortar
H4389.brief: A district or valley in or near Jerusalem
H4389.short: The Mortar was a district or valley in or near Jerusalem, mentioned in Zephaniah's prophecy.

H4325H.name: Water Gate
H4325H.brief: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
H4325H.short: The Water Gate, one of the gates in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah and associated with the reading of the Law and the celebration of the Feast of Tabernacles (<ref="Neh. 3:26; 8:1, 3, 16; 12:37">Neh. 3:26; 8:1, 3, 16; 12:37</ref>).

H4387.name: Miktam
H4387.brief: A musical or literary term used in Psalm titles.
H4387.short: Miktam is a musical or literary term of uncertain meaning used in Psalm titles.
